new_findings.title: Invalid Osborn zoning polygon excluded from screening
new_findings.description: Captured LUPC zoning OBJECTID 27232839 (P-WL2) has a ring self-intersection. Preserve its original geometry; exclusion means apparent uncovered area cannot be interpreted as unregulated land.

reviews.next_action: Confirm current-zone selection with publisher evidence; reconcile polygon dates and map-omitted protections before legal zoning use.
reviews.note: Captured 383 Osborn polygons with reconciled membership. All flags are Yes and END_DATE null, but no authoritative legal-current predicate is established. The official map's 2024 amendment is a clerical FEMA-reference correction; rule-based protections can be omitted from its drawing.

reviews.next_action: Qualify authoritative municipal digital boundaries and current adoption/effective dates for Kingsbury, Sweden and Alfred; resolve Alfred publication access through an authorized source.
reviews.note: Archived municipal Kingsbury and Sweden maps/ordinances. Kingsbury's municipal ordinance cover has blank enactment/amendment dates and its map date is malformed; a historical LUPC map link is 404. Sweden's map is approximate. Alfred's official page links to eCode360, whose archive request returned 403. No municipal polygons qualified; affected records remain UNKNOWN.

reviews.next_action: Compare the invalid polygon with native source geometry and official map evidence; retain an excluded original unless a reviewed alternate interpretation is justified.
reviews.note: One invalid Osborn P-WL2 polygon is archived and excluded without repair. Screening records flag the incomplete capture and identify the source record whose envelope may overlap it.
